svg.title: Toktogul Hydroelectric Complex
svg.desc: The Toktogul dam site since the 2009 protocol: the dam and powerhouse, the switchyard and national dispatch centre, the Naryn bridge checkpoint and Kara-Köl, all in the ISEZ, with State Route 1, the export lines and the Qara-Chik line on the slopes above. Positions, zones and lines: Kartalar map data. Relief and contours: SRTM via the AWS Terrain Tiles (public domain).

g.text: All of the map lies inside the 12 km
